How it works

Deploy in 3 simple steps

Our 2D AI avatars enable real-time conversations that feel natural and engaging. With seamless integration options, businesses can easily embed these avatars into their websites.

Upload & Train Your Knowledge

Securely upload your content (only pdf). Our AI learns from it and builds a knowledge base tailored to your business.

Customize Your Avatar

Choose a voice, persona, and avatar style that matches your brand's tone and purpose.

Integrate Instantly

Embed your interactive AI avatar on your website with an iframe. Our team provides end-to-end support.
